critical.issue: Router writes to TABLE 'material_board_items' which does NOT exist in the schema. Postgres error: "Could not find the table 'public.material_board_items' in the schema cache" — hint: 'Perhaps you meant the table public.material_board_elements'. Effect: (a) every sync silently fails to persist items (the bare-except in the fallback also swallows the error), (b) the dedup query existing_eids := SELECT entity_id FROM material_board_items also returns [], so every consecutive idempotent call re-emits added>=1 instead of added=0, (c) created_board still returns true and decision_stage='specified' is still written to elements — giving the FRONTEND the illusion of success while the Material Board stays empty. This breaks the entire Material Board Sync™ feature in production. All other routers in /app/backend (material_boards.py, specifications.py, project_stories.py) correctly use 'material_board_elements'. FIX: rename all three occurrences in /app/backend/routers/working_moodboards.py (lines 843, 878, 887) from 'material_board_items' → 'material_board_elements' AND verify columns (source_element_id, source_moodboard_id, added_by may need rename/removal per actual material_board_elements schema).

minor.issue: Both insert paths are wrapped in try/except that LOGS but does not re-raise — masks DB errors and returns added=N to the client even when zero rows were actually persisted. Recommend: re-raise after fallback fails so HTTP 500 is returned to the UI.

approval_status='approved' inserts AND material_board sync both write decision_stage but in different code paths. Approval writes 'approved', sync writes 'specified'. If sync fails silently (current bug) element stays at decision_stage='specified' yet Material Board has no row — desync between badge state and reality.

rca_of_the_issue: ROOT CAUSE: /app/backend/routers/working_moodboards.py was written against a table called 'material_board_items' but the actual schema uses 'material_board_elements' (confirmed by Postgres hint and by all sibling routers material_boards.py, specifications.py, project_stories.py). REPRODUCTION: POST /api/working-moodboards/47821aa0.../sync-materials-board twice in a row → both calls return added=1 instead of the second returning added=0. Backend log shows: APIError PGRST205 'Could not find the table public.material_board_items'. MITIGATION: rename 3 string occurrences to 'material_board_elements' and reconcile insert payload columns with the actual schema (drop unsupported keys like source_element_id/source_moodboard_id/added_by if they don't exist on that table).
